# Labels

<!-- Generated by skill `init-dsh-project` v1.8 on 2026-10-26. -->

Every issue has exactly one **primary label**; `Severity:` and `Size:` are two other columns and
do not mix into the label.

## Primary labels (mutually exclusive)

| Label | Meaning | Who moves it |
|---|---|---|
| `needs-triage` | Not judged yet: information is missing, or whether to do it is undecided | a human |
| `needs-info` | Judged, but the **criteria / repro are insufficient**; nobody starts until they are filled in | whoever filed it |
| `ready-for-agent` | Criteria clear, boundaries clear, **can be handed straight to a sub-agent** | an agent |
| `ready-for-human` | Needs human judgement / a real device / an account / money | a human |
| `wontfix` | Explicitly not doing it; the reason is in the body | — |

## Status (written in the `Status:` line, not a label)

`open` · `in-progress` · `⏸ DEFERRED (<date>) → <where the decision lives>` · `closed-verified (<date>)`.

Compound statuses are allowed but must be explained inline: `closed-verified (superseded by
ADR-0012)`, `shipped-dormant (reactivation trigger: <…>)`.

## Severity

| Severity | Criterion |
|---|---|
| `critical` | Producing **wrong conclusions** right now, or corrupting data |
| `high` | The main path is unusable, or its results are untrustworthy and nobody has noticed yet |
| `medium` | There is a detour; the cost is acceptable |
| `low` | Polish |

## When it is not an issue

- A **large unit of work** (multiple weeks, multiple legs) → that is an epic / huge epic: open an
  umbrella issue + a research directory + a SOT, and put it in the ledger's milestones, not as an
  ordinary row in this directory.
- A **progress note** → the ledger; a **trap** → `30-Areas/Technology/<tool>.md`.
